text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after school. Faced with a mountain of paperwork,
I couldn't help but slump over my desk.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Oh…… That face.
Your battery is completely drained, isn't it?"
choice_data_list: Sorry, I'm kinda swamped right now...
Sorry, things are a bit hectic right now...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "At times like this, the priority is to get yourself in order. Time to recharge!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Want to try doing my fatigue recovery
routine together?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, to get into shape physically and mentally,
I was taken to a dance studio
by Daring Heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
When the body is in disarray, the mind wavers too.
And vice versa.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's why at the end of every day,
I always align my breathing and posture.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
For instance, like this—
Copy my pose.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as long as it's within your range of movement, that's fine.
Find what feels "just right" for you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And take a long, hard look.
—At who you truly are.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart lectures in a calm, steady voice.
Feeling reassured by her tone, my body gradually begins to relax.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Close your eyes this time.
Breathe in slowly... and out...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
――Imagine... We are deep inside a lush forest.
You can hear the cheerful songs of little birds.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The wind gently strokes your cheek.
Sunlight filters through the trees—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: See? You can feel it, can't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now, take a deeper breath.
Focus your awareness on my words.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now, breathe in............
And breathe out............

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I focused on Daring Heart's voice
and took a deep breath.
Her voice resonated comfortably, and...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. Looking good.
Your color's finally back.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now that body and mind are in peak condition, this is our chance.
I'll begin putting on the finishing touches.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks for waiting!
Here's my special banana and Japanese mustard spinach smoothie.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I added some honey as a little bonus today.
Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The moment I tasted the smoothie I was handed, a refreshing sweetness spread throughout my entire body—
choice_data_list: It feels like my whole body is rejoicing...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Heheh, naturally. A drink after tuning yourself up hits different, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Joy for the heart, nourishment for the body.
That's my personal rule♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The nutrients smoothly absorb into my conditioned body.
It's as if my exhaustion from earlier was just an illusion."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
No need to thank me!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I can't have the trainer of a future queen
walking around looking like a zombie, after all."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Besides, I want you to show me your reliable side.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Always for you, right?
choice_data_list: Then we've got to do our best to live up to those expectations.
Then I'll have to do my best to live up to those expectations.
Could you tell me more about your routine?
Will you tell me more about your routine?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Always for you, right?
choice_data_list: Then we've got to do our best to live up to those expectations.
Then I'll have to do my best to live up to those expectations.
Could you tell me more about your routine?
Will you tell me more about your routine?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh! How earnest of you.
In that case, make sure you remember this well.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You are my precious buddy.
No one else could ever take your place.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "So please, take better care of yourself."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Sounds good!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: For example, watching candle flames or practicing mindfulness can leave you feeling refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you some other routines I recommend.
Follow me!
